data.name: FaqLead
data.value: Find answers to your questions here. Contact us for more information.

data.name: Faq1Q
data.value: What is AntAbstract and what does it do?

data.name: Faq1A
data.value: AntAbstract is a SaaS platform for digitally managing scientific congresses and conferences. It enables you to manage abstract submission, peer review, participant registration, payment, program, and certificate processes from a single panel.

data.name: Faq2Q
data.value: How do I submit an abstract?

data.name: Faq2A
data.value: Authors can submit their abstracts through the conference page with a title, abstract, keywords, and PDF file. Drag-and-drop file upload is supported.

data.name: Faq3Q
data.value: Which payment methods do you support?

data.name: Faq3A
data.value: You can accept payments via Stripe (international credit card), PayTR (Turkey credit card), and bank transfer/EFT. Receipt upload and admin approval are also supported.

data.name: Faq4A
data.value: Yes. When blind review is enabled, author information is automatically removed from submission files and presented anonymously to reviewers.

data.name: Faq5Q
data.value: Can I create a custom website for my conference?

data.name: Faq5A
data.value: Yes. A dynamic website is automatically created for each conference, including custom pages, content blocks, speakers, sponsors, and program information.

data.name: Faq6A
data.value: You can request a demo to evaluate the platform. Contact us through our contact page for detailed information.

data.name: Faq7A
data.value: Yes. Author and reviewer certificates can be generated in bulk by the admin after submissions are accepted or reviews are completed. Participants can download their certificates as PDF from their panel.

data.name: Faq8Q
data.value: Can multiple conferences be managed simultaneously?

data.name: Faq8A
data.value: Yes. AntAbstract's multi-tenant architecture isolates each conference. You can manage multiple conferences simultaneously with a single admin account.

data.name: Faq9A
data.value: Yes. DOIs can be assigned manually or automatically via DataCite integration to accepted submissions. DOI numbers are displayed on submission detail pages and in proceeding books.

data.name: Faq10A
data.value: Accepted submissions are selected from the admin panel to automatically generate a proceeding book. The book can be published publicly on the conference website.

data.name: Faq11A
data.value: Yes. You can send bulk emails to participants, authors, or reviewers using customizable email templates. Scheduled sending and placeholder support are also available.

data.name: Faq12A
data.value: AntAbstract protects your data with mandatory HTTPS, security headers (CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options), encrypted file storage, and role-based access control. Sensitive files are only accessible to authorized users.
